text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al Abidine Ben Ali confered with Prime Minister Hamed Karoui on speeding up export sector.
- Foreign Affairs Minister Abderrahim Zouari holds talks with Algerian leaders. He was received by President Liamine Zeroual and Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia.
- Argentina's deputy president Carlos Ruckauf to start a visit to Tunisia on July 18.
- Qatar Health Minister Abdulrahman Salem al-Kawari is expected to visit Tunisia on July 16.
